academicYear: Current Programme page and 2026-27 course offerings
note: The CUHK admission page links the Department of History's current Public History Programme page. That page states a minimum 57-unit Major Programme Requirement and publishes two Required Course highlights plus eight Elective Course highlights, but it does not publish the complete coded curriculum or per-course units. Codes and titles are cross-checked against the Department's official Study Scheme, 2026-27 Course Offerings and archived course records. HIST4702 is the curriculum code for Digital History; the 2026-27 offering is listed as section HIST4702RS. The archived Ordinary Voices offering is listed as HIST4180RH and is preserved with that official section code because the current Programme page does not publish a stable base code. The current Programme page misspells Documentaries as Documentories; the title below follows the official course archive. All ten courses remain credit-unknown and form only a partial read-only planning list. They must not be treated as the complete 57-unit curriculum or produce a graduation completion percentage.
